prefix.description: SEL-2730M Managed Ethernet Switch (fixed model/generation prefix; 24 ports: 4 SFP cages [Ports 1-4], 4 copper 10/100/1000BASE-T [Ports 5-8], 16 configurable 10/100 Mbps [Ports 9-24])

part_number.note: 19-digit Model Option Table from WI-9662. No SEL-2730M drawing layers exist and no genuine part number was available to calibrate against, so option codes are taken from the ordering document and digit positions are calibrated by column-alignment against the WI-9662 part-number template grid; all option-bearing positions are marked low confidence. Positions 1-7 are the fixed 2730M0A prefix. Ports 9-24 (positions 11-14) is one 4-digit combined selection, not four independent digits. Ports 5-8 are fixed copper gigabit and Ports 1-4 SFP cages are populated via the Installed SFPs field / accessory SFP part numbers (8115/8130/8131), not by a config digit.
references: SEL-2730M Managed Ethernet Switch Instruction Manual (2730M_IM_20250217)

positions.label: Installed SFPs (Slots 1-4)
positions.note: One digit per SFP cage (Ports 1-4). The MOT documents only the copper (8115-01) SFP as a factory-installed option; other SFP transceivers (8130/8131 accessory part numbers) are ordered separately and field-installed. WI-9662 shows the all-none (AAAA) and all-copper (CCCC) rows; per-slot mixing is represented here as independent digits. Doc-derived; column-calibrated against the WI-9662 template grid, not verified against a genuine part number.
